query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "n!"
            FROM t_part_batch b
            WHERE b.status = 'IN_PROCESS'
              AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
              AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM t_part p
                  WHERE p.id = b.part_id
                    AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
              )
              AND b.updated_at::text LIKE $1
